walkthroughs.body_html:
Magnification = image ÷ real.

To find real size, divide image by magnification. Convert units first — 1 mm = 1000 μm.

A cell appears 20 mm across at ×400 magnification.

Real size = 20 ÷ 400 = 0.05 mm = 50 μm.

Doctors plot mass and height vs age. On the 50th percentile, half the children are heavier and half lighter.

A drop across two centile lines is a red flag.
